stories.headline: Rice launches a campuswide AI initiative
stories.summary: Rice said it will hire 75 faculty, build new facilities, and expand AI courses and degrees across the university.
stories.why_it_matters: Big university bet on AI talent, infrastructure, and training.

stories.headline: Google Public Sector and SUNY launch AI platform
stories.summary: Google and SUNY introduced an AI-enabled platform to help accelerate university research and reuse scientific workflows.
stories.why_it_matters: Could speed up academic research at scale across a large university system.

stories.headline: Georgia Tech gets Google.org AI grant
stories.summary: Georgia Tech said Google.org is funding tools and workflows to expand AI for scientific discovery.
stories.why_it_matters: Fresh funding helps turn AI research ideas into usable scientific tools.
